attention_roi.local_visual_anchor: 倍速 indicator 文本 (OFF/2倍速/3倍速), 紧邻 Auto 按钮右侧, 暂停按钮左侧
attention_roi.read_method: coarse native vision 截取 ROI 文本, 禁全屏 OCR, 禁 AGY

separate_states.battle_auto_state: ON | OFF | UNKNOWN (ROI: Auto 按钮 x∈[0.79,0.85])

flow: fresh read Speed FIRST (进入 battle 后必读, 禁止沿用上次状态)
Speed != X3 → click speed control → fresh read → 重复至 X3 或超限(max 3)
Speed == X3 后 → fresh read Auto; Auto OFF → click once → fresh read ON
notes: 点击一次不必然 +1 档, 必须每次 fresh read

test_matrix.x2_one_click_to_x3: OBSERVED (WINGRUN S1 audition: OFF→点击→2倍速; x3 段未观察)
test_matrix.no_stale_reuse: PASS (每次进 battle fresh read 已为既有纪律)

evidence_tier: PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTED (x2→click 路径有 run 证据; x3/x1/UNKNOWN 路径待运行时观察)

ordering_rule.rule: SPEED_FIRST_THEN_AUTO — 进入 battle 后必须先设置倍速至 X3，再开 Auto；Auto ON 后倍速控件锁定不可再改
ordering_rule.evidence: S3 50k audition live finding: Auto ON 后点击倍速无效果(2次尝试保持2倍速)
correct_sequence: 1. fresh read Speed (ROI: 倍速 indicator)
2. Speed != X3 → toggle Speed → fresh read (bounded 3)
4. Auto OFF → click Auto once → fresh read
ordering_rule.wrong_sequence_superseded: 先 Auto 后 Speed (旧流程, 已证实失败)
